items.title: JSW MG Motor launches Majestor SUV at ₹40.99 lakh
items.summary: The MG Majestor, positioned as India’s first D+ SUV, targets premium buyers with segment-first triple locking differentials, a Level 2 ADAS suite, and 4x4 terrain management modes.

items.title: New MG Majestor SUV Launch Price Rs 40.99 Lakh
items.summary: Prices start at Rs 40.99 lakh (ex-sh) for the 4x2 Automatic top trim, while the fully-loaded 4x4 Automatic variant is priced at Rs 44.99 lakh (ex-sh) The post New MG Majestor SUV Launch Price Rs 40.99 Lakh appeared first on RushLane .

items.title: New Honda City Facelift Gets Sportier RS Variant In Thailand
items.summary: In Thailand, Honda offers the City sedan and the hatchback version, both of which have received comprehensive updates The post New Honda City Facelift Gets Sportier RS Variant In Thailand appeared first on RushLane .

items.title: Honda launches facelifted City at ₹11.99 lakh, debuts ZR-V hybrid as new flagship SUV
items.summary: The new City features refreshed styling, new technology features and both petrol and strong hybrid powertrain options, while the ZR-V is powered by Honda’s 2.0-litre e:HEV strong hybrid system.

items.title: Mercedes-Benz launches limited-run Night Edition GLE, GLS SUVs in India
items.summary: Prices for the Night Edition GLS 450 and GLS 450d have been set at ₹1.41 crore and ₹1.43 crore respectively, while the GLE 300d and GLE 450 Night Editions are priced at ₹1.05 crore and ₹1.14 crore, respectively.
